dct_title_s: Sea-floor images and data from multibeam surveys in San Francisco Bay, Southern California, Hawaii, the Gulf of Mexico, and Lake Tahoe, California--Nevada
dct_alternative_sm: Sea floor images and data from multibeam surveys in San Francisco Bay
Pacific Sea-Floor Mapping Project, multibeam survey images and data
dct_description_sm: by Peter Dartnell and James V. Gardner.
"In cooperation with the Ocean Mapping Group, University of New Brunswick, Fredericton, Canada ..."--Verso of container.

Interactive CD-ROM that contains images, maps, movies, and data from all surveys the Pacific Seafloor Mapping Project has completed up to January 1999. Contains shaded relief of bathymetry, backscatter, oblique and 3-D views, and QuickTime movies. Also contains ARC/INFO export (.e00) files and full-resolution TIFF images of all sites that can be downloaded and used in many GIS packages.
Also available on Internet from USGS Web site. (Address as of 1/12/00: http://wrgis.wr.usgs.gov/dds/dds-55; current access is available via PURL).
System requirements: Windows: 95 or NT 4.0 with 386 PC (Pentium recommended); Macintosh: 68020 or higher (PowerPC recommended).
All platforms: CD-ROM drive; monitor capable of displaying at least 256 colors; image processing software capable of importing TIFF images.
